description: Mouse model evidence for MSH3: Apc mutation spectrum shift to frameshifts, absence of a single-mutant intestinal tumour phenotype, and IMPC null phenotypes
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16, 5.2))

# Panel A: Apc mutation spectrum in Apc1638N mouse tumours (Kuraguchi 2001, PMID 11691815)
ax = axes[0]
gen = ["Msh6-/-\nApc1638N", "Msh3-/- Msh6-/-\nApc1638N"]
base = np.array([93, 46]); fs = np.array([7, 54])
ax.bar(gen, base, color="#4C72B0", label="base substitution (stop codon)")
ax.bar(gen, fs, bottom=base, color="#DD8452", label="frameshift indel")
for i,(b,f) in enumerate(zip(base, fs)):
    ax.text(i, b/2, f"{b}%", ha="center", va="center", color="white", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(i, b+f/2, f"{f}%", ha="center", va="center", color="white", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
ax.set_ylabel("share of tumour-associated Apc mutations (%)")
ax.set_title("A. Msh3 loss shifts somatic Apc mutations\nto frameshifts (PMID 11691815, mouse)", fontsize=10.5)
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5, loc="lower center"); ax.set_ylim(0, 112)

# Panel B: intestinal tumour multiplicity fold change on Apc1638N background
ax = axes[1]
labels = ["Apc1638N", "Msh3-/-\nApc1638N", "Msh6-/-\nApc1638N", "Msh3-/- Msh6-/-\nApc1638N"]
fold = [1.0, 1.0, 6.5, 6.5]
cols = ["#8C8C8C", "#55A868", "#C44E52", "#C44E52"]
ax.bar(labels, fold, color=cols)
ax.axhline(1.0, color="#333333", lw=1, ls="--")
ax.text(1, 1.25, "no difference\nin multiplicity\nor survival", ha="center", fontsize=8.5, color="#2d6a4f")
ax.text(3, 5.2, "survival further\nreduced vs Msh6-/-\n(younger onset)", ha="center", fontsize=8.5, color="white")
ax.set_ylabel("intestinal tumour multiplicity (fold vs Apc1638N)")
ax.set_title("B. Single Msh3 loss does not increase mouse\nintestinal tumours; it acts with Msh6", fontsize=10.5)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=8.5)

# Panel C: IMPC Msh3 homozygote significant calls
ax = axes[2]
ph = ["enlarged kidney", "abnormal kidney\nmorphology", "cataract", "abnormal vitreous\nbody morphology", "abnormal retina\nmorphology"]
pv = [1e-12, 1e-12, 3.18e-10, 2.92e-10, 4.38e-5]
ax.barh(ph, [-np.log10(p) for p in pv], color="#937860")
ax.set_xlabel("-log10 p (IMPC homozygote vs control)")
ax.set_title("C. IMPC Msh3-null mouse pipeline: eye and kidney\ncalls only, no intestinal or tumour phenotype", fontsize=10.5)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=8.5)
ax.text(0.98, 0.06, "p reported as 0.0 for kidney calls,\nplotted at 1e-12", transform=ax.transAxes,
        ha="right", fontsize=7.5, color="#555555")

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
